msg: Good evening. I'm an Advanced diver and underwater photographer, staying at a hotel on Isla Grande. I only want to do the night dive, with my own camera. Is one night dive possible on its own? What does it cost?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

Good evening! Since you’re already on Isla Grande, a single dive is available, but the standalone option is listed as a regular dive—not specifically as a night dive. The night dive is included in the 3-dive package, which also has two daytime dives. I can’t confirm a night dive on its own from the available information; would you like me to connect you with a team advisor to check whether that can be arranged?

You can bring your own camera at your own risk; we don’t rent cameras. I’m leaving the prices for the available options below.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• 3-dive package (1 day, 2 daytime + 1 night dive): 188 USD · 209 USD (665.000 COP · 739.000 COP)
• Fun Dives - 1 dive (1 day): 97 USD · 108 USD (345.000 COP · 383.000 COP)
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 124 USD · 138 USD (440.000 COP · 489.000 COP)

From the islands we coordinate pick-up and drop-off at your hotel if it has maritime access, or at the nearest dock we point you to.
